target_customer: Pharma, biotech, clinical trial designers and healthcare providers that need predictive models of human physiology and behavior
problem: Rare and hard to access human behavior and physiology data limits prediction in medicine. Mantis combines LLMs with physics simulation to build digital twins that fill the data gap.
business_model: B2B platform where customers request scoped predictions from digital twins, pricing not stated
product_category: digital twins of humans for healthcare and biomedical research

founders.name: Georgia Witchel
education: BS Computer Science, Harvey Mudd College
previous_startups: Louiza Labs (YC company, outcome not found)
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page, a former elite ice climber with world records who dropped out of high school.

competitors.name: Twin Health
competitors.what: AI digital twin of metabolic health paired with human care teams

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining LLMs with high fidelity physics simulation to produce predictive human twins from sparse data is research grade work, with a founding team of three.

defensibility.rationale: If the models validate on rare data they could be hard to copy, but no validated results or customers are public yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found as of late 2026.

market_need_then: Medicine suffers from data availability gaps for rare conditions and trial populations, and coverage in 2025 and 2026 shows steady investment in healthcare digital twins.

branding.domain_note: Uses mantisbiotech.com, so the exact mantis.com domain was not used.

identity.logo: blue and black logo marks per the site
identity.visual_style: minimalist layout, sentence case headlines ending in periods
identity.voice_and_tone: scientific and ambitious, with chaos theory metaphors and a no data selling pledge

branding.brand_signature: The line that the last system without a digital twin is the human being

brand_strength.rationale: Launch coverage exists but no source shows community, merch or brand focused press. The name is shared with many other Mantis companies.

outcome_analysis: Mantis is a Winter 2026 company with a single founder that raised a reported seed of about 7.4 million dollars led by Decibel. There is no exit or failure signal. The story so far rests on a hard research problem, a planned rare disease pilot, and a founder with biomedical startup experience, while validation with paying customers is still unproven.
notes: Funding sources conflict. A startup tracker lists a 6.3M dollar seed led by Decibel dated 2026-01-30, a crypto news site dates a 7.4M seed to April 2025, one low reliability site claims a 48M Series A, and other aggregators list Series A figures. I recorded only the 7.4M seed from the outlet dated 2026-04-02 and treat the others as unverified. Only the YC page lists Witchel, so co-founders if any are unknown. Team size 3 per the YC page. A YC page also exists under the slug mantis-biotechnology.
